note: ADR-0011 §3.2 and §3.3. The triode stage is held to an ngspice simulation of the same netlist (tests/spice/, made by the SPICE reference harness): operating point, fundamental, and every harmonic up to 20 kHz at or above spice.floor_dbc, at the default quality's oversampled rates; the processor's harmonic levels through the oversampler at 44.1, 48 and 96 kHz. Aliasing (non-harmonic energy in 20 Hz-20 kHz on tones from 1 to 19 kHz at the nominal drive, the default drive with a -6 dBFS tone): §3.2's -90 dBc for the default quality, -70 dBc for eco. The zipper tone is -40 dBFS, so full drive stays clean enough that the harmonics are not read as steps; the bar moves with it (checks.cpp). Class B (colour, §3.5).
